title: What is NSDC?
content: The National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) is a public-private organization under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship that promotes skill development, vocational training, apprenticeships, and employability across India.

title: What is Skill India Digital?
content: Skill India Digital is the unified digital platform where learners can register, complete e-KYC, discover skill courses, apply for batches, access apprenticeships, and manage their learning profile.

title: Who can register?
content: Any learner interested in skill development can create a Skill India Digital account using their mobile number. Eligibility for specific courses depends on the individual program.

title: Create Skill India Digital account
content: Open Skill India Digital, click Register, enter your mobile number, verify the OTP, create your account PIN/password, and proceed to complete your learner profile.

title: Login to Skill India Digital
content: Use your registered mobile number and the 4-digit account PIN/password created during registration to log into your learner account.

title: Forgot login password
content: If you cannot access your account, use the registered mobile number to verify your identity and reset your account PIN/password through OTP verification.

title: What is e-KYC?
content: e-KYC is the Aadhaar-based identity verification process that validates your learner profile before applying for many Skill India programs and services.

title: Complete Aadhaar OTP e-KYC
content: Login to Skill India Digital, open Complete your e-KYC, enter your Aadhaar number, provide consent, receive the OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile number, and verify successfully.

title: Complete biometric e-KYC
content: Users with a supported biometric fingerprint device can choose the Biometric option during e-KYC and authenticate using their fingerprint instead of OTP.

title: Not receiving Aadhaar OTP
content: Check whether your mobile number is linked with Aadhaar, verify network connectivity, and retry after some time. If the issue continues, contact Skill India Digital support.

title: Find skill courses
content: Open the Courses section and search using sector, job role, location, training provider, or scheme to discover relevant skill development programs.

title: Search by sector
content: Courses are organized across multiple sectors such as IT, Healthcare, Electronics, Retail, Tourism, Agriculture, and many other industry domains.

title: Apply for a training batch
content: After completing e-KYC, select a scheme, choose a job role, review available batches, verify the training centre and timing, then click Show Interest.

title: Maximum batch selection
content: A learner can show interest in up to five training batches while applying through Skill India Digital.

title: Track application status
content: Go to My Dashboard → Applications to view Pending, Approved, and Accepted applications after applying for training batches.

title: What is My Dashboard?
content: The learner dashboard allows you to manage your profile, courses, applications, batches, certificates, and learning progress from one place.

title: Digital certificates
content: Eligible learners receive digital certificates after successfully completing approved training and certification processes. Certificate availability depends on the specific program.

title: What can employers do?
content: Employers can discover skilled candidates, participate in apprenticeship and hiring initiatives, and engage with Skill India talent through NSDC's ecosystem.

title: Training Partners and Institutions
content: Training Partners can manage centres, create courses, create batches, enroll candidates, record attendance, and support assessment through the NSDC ecosystem.

title: Technical support
content: If you experience registration, login, e-KYC, or batch-related issues, submit a support ticket through the official NSDC Technical Support portal with your registered details and issue description.
